message.content:
Below is everything you’ll need to cast a “malicious” vote against `22.242.75.136` on VirusTotal’s v3 API.  
(Replace `<YOUR_API_KEY>` with **your actual** `key_four`; keep that secret!)

---

### 1️⃣ Endpoint & Method  

```
POST   https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes
```

> *Why this URL?*  
> In VT‑v3 each resource has its own endpoint. For votes on an IP you append `/votes`.

---

### 2️⃣ Headers  

| Header            | Value |
|-------------------|-------|
| `Authorization`   | `Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>` |
| `Content-Type`    | `application/json` |

> ⚠️ Make sure there are **no spaces** after the colon in the `Authorization` header – otherwise the token will be rejected.

---

### 3️⃣ Request body (JSON)

```json
{
  "type":       "vote",
  "attributes": {
      "verdict": "malicious"
  }
}
```

> • `"type"` must always be `"vote"`.  
> • `"verdict"` accepts one of: `"benign"`, `"suspicious"`, `"harmless"`, `"unverified"`, `"unknown"`, `"malicious"`.  
> • You’re free to add optional fields (`commentary`) if you wish to explain why you think the IP is bad.

---

### 4️⃣ Example cURL Command

```bash
curl --request POST \
     --url https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes \
     --header "Accept: application/json" \
     --header "Content-Type: application/json" \
     --header "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>" \
     --data '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'
```

If you prefer PowerShell:

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod `
  -Uri 'https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes' `
  -Headers @{ 
        Accept='application/json'; 
        ContentType='application/json';
        Authorization="Bearer $env:VT_APIKEY" } `
  -Body ('{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}') `
  -Method Post
```

*(Assuming `$env:VT_APIKEY` holds your key.)*

---

### 5️⃣ What Happens Next?

Once the request succeeds, you’ll receive a response similar to:

```json
{
  "_id":          "...",
  "created_at":   "...",
  "updated_at":   "...",
  "type":         "vote",
  "links": { ... },
  "relationships": { ... },
  "attributes": {
      "verdict": "malicious",
      ...
  }
}
```

Your vote becomes part of the public dataset. Other users’ votes influence the overall reputation score shown on the IP detail page.

---

#### Quick Checklist Before Sending

| ✅ | Item |
|----|------|
| ✔︎ | Have you verified that `key_four` belongs to a role authorized to vote? |
| ✔︎ | Are you sure the verdict should be `"malicious"`? A wrong vote could mislead others. |
| ✔︎ | Is your network allowing outbound HTTPS traffic to `api.victor...com`? |
| ✔︎ | Did you set the proper headers exactly as listed above? |

---

That’s all! Once you hit **Send**, your vote will be recorded. If you run into errors, double‑check the error message—most common issues are missing/incorrect auth, malformed JSON, or hitting the daily quota limit. Happy voting!
